newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Tuesday on caution the market was too high after recent rises capped price gains, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kilogram lower to 0.6 yen firmer than the day's close. The newly listed benchmark May contract was up by 0.4 yen at 145.4 yen. Volume was 8,966 lots.

During the day, technical driven profit-taking pressured the market. One trader said, however, falls in rubber stocks as of November 20 could provide support to the market on Wednesday. The data released after the market closed.
